high_level_description: stc brand style, a set of flat purple and pink streaming app interface mockups shown on overlapping browser and phone screens.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A plain white background with a purple and red color-block accent bar.

elements.desc: A browser window mockup showing a video streaming homepage with a play icon logo, a movie title placeholder, and a row of show thumbnails.
A second browser window mockup showing a grid of category icons and two rows of video thumbnails under 'Originals' and 'Continue Watching' labels.
A phone screen mockup showing a streaming series page with a play button and a row of thumbnails labeled 'Live Now'.
